title: Unit Event — Echo My Melody — Episode5 Let's Take A Video!

meta.Event Outline: After putting on a successful show, Leo/need decides to start posting videos to a video platform so that their music can reach more people. Meanwhile, Ichika tries to help out the band by creating songs using digital tools, but is still struggling...

rows.Line: A few days later
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The day when Leo/need shoots its very first video has finally arrived!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yay♪>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Hehe. This should be fun.
Especially considering how much you girls practiced for this day.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Ichi, you gotta sing the best you possibly can today.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yawn...
Oh, um... Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Did you not get much sleep last night, Ichika...?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Maybe it's because of all the practice you've been doing.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, I'm just...
Yes, I'm a little tired from practicing, but there's another reason...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
Did you stay up late playing video games or something?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's not you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I don't stay up super late playing video games... That much...! Even if I do it sometimes with movies and manga!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Don't those all fall into one category?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Are you sure you're okay, Ichika?
Do you feel tired because...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay.
There's no need to worry.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm actually almost finished with it.
I just need to make some final adjustments.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
...!
Really?! That's wonderful...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But choosing just one is taking more time than I initially expected. I've been trying to remember what Kanade said the other day, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's okay to give something important a lot of thought. In any case, Ichika, I'll be looking forward to hearing your song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, what are you two talking about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uhh... N-Nothing!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start shooting since we've asked Miku and the others to come over from SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
R-Right.
I brought a few different smartphone tripods with me today. I'm hoping that they'll allow us to take a nice video.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, I haven't seen one of those before...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was wondering why you were carrying so much stuff today, Hona! It was all stuff for our shoot!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But do we really need all these tripods...? We're only using one camera, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it'll be difficult for us to make a dynamic video with just one camera. Using several will give us shots from different angles, which we can stitch together for our music video.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, would it be okay if I borrowed your phones...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure, I don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're always super reliable, Hona, but you seem like you're really on your game today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you, but this is nothing special, really!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I want to do what I can since this video is going to help determine Leo/need's future...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, let's take a really awesome video!
Get ready! We're on standby♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, Saki, don't push...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, we're in position now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
How do we look?
Are we all in the frame?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <No problems with this camera.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Same here!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Ours looks good too.
I think you girls can start shooting.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Alright, then...
Should we start playing?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm getting nervous... And not like when we're about to do a show either...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, we're not trying to do this in one take. We can always shoot again if we don't like what we see. So, let's just give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, let's just try to relax and play the way we practiced...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll count us in.
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I don't understand. We all seem to be playing just fine...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But something feels different...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hmmmm...?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<We've done quite a few takes already...
But something does seem strange here...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
And it's not like they have been playing bad...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<But it's like...
I dunno how to describe it!!!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <They're not playing with enough power...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah, that!
Nice one, KAITO!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <They're all clearly playing like they mean it... But they're not quite fully committed.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wanna stop for a sec...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I knew it. We're missing our usual power.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I kept trying to refocus myself after each take, but I can't seem to play the way I do during shows...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The way we play during shows...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We really gave it everything we had that time... It almost felt like each note shined, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I totally know what you mean!
Before the show, the tension felt kinda different compared to normal...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And things were completely different during it! I could hear the audience talking and stuff like always, but I was way more focused on the show itself...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it'd make for a great video if we could play like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's easier said than done...
We were able to play that way because of the crowd and the atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Then, why not try to recreate that...?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, I think I get what he means.
I doubt you girls have a spare live house just lying around...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<But what if you had some spectators?
We can be your crowd!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, I get it!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We get to have Leo/need play a special concert just for us☆>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A special show just for you...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that could actually work...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I agree.
It'll help to have a visible crowd that we want to have hear our song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll do everything we can to give you guys the best performance possible, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. Let's see what you can do.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, it's time for Leo/need's special show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!
